newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Rolls-Royce 1996 Asian sales over 1 bln stg.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce 1996 Asian sales over 1 bln stg.

text.p: Rolls Royce Plc sales in Asia reached 1.23 billion pounds in 1996, compared to 753 million pounds a year earlier and accounted for a quarter of total sales, the company said in a statement.
The region also contributed a quarter of the aerospace and industrial power group's seven billion pounds order book, it added.
In London the company announced total annual sales of of 4.05 billion pounds for 1996 compared to 3.34 billion pounds a year earlier.
Rolls Royce said its Trent aircraft engine continued its successful run of new orders in the region, particularly in south east Asia where it continues to power every Boeing 777 ordered.

New Trent 700 orders have been won from Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd. Malaysia Airline System Bhd and Singapore Aircraft Leasing Enterprise has ordered Trent 800 engines for their new 777 fleets, the statement said. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax-5017
